Class Tokenizer

java.lang.Object
smile.onnx.genai.Tokenizer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class Tokenizer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Converts between text and GenAI token ids, including chat templates.

      public String applyChatTemplate(String templateStr, String messagesJson, String toolsJson, boolean addGenerationPrompt)
      Applies the model's chat template.
      Parameters:
      templateStr - template string, or null to use the model default.
      messagesJson - messages as a JSON array string.
      toolsJson - tools JSON, or null when unused.
      addGenerationPrompt - whether to append the assistant generation prompt.
      Returns:
      formatted prompt text.
